metadata.name: Workflow Example
metadata.description: Create, read, resume and cancel workflow runs with this plugin's HTTP OAuth connection
metadata.permission: Run workflows you can execute, then read, resume and cancel this plugin's runs with its OAuth identity (cloud execution may incur charges)

help: Cloud calls require your explicit action. Execution and resume may incur charges. Closing this page aborts HTTP only; use Cancel run and read the terminal state to cancel in the cloud.
configure: OAuth Client ID is not configured. Replace the Manifest placeholder with this plugin's authorized client, rebuild, and authorize through the normal installation flow.
askHelp: Free-text answers only. Obtain the Ask Key from this run through an authorized view. Success may mark an ask stage; the server validates pending answers.
cancelling: Cancel accepted; read and confirm the cancelled terminal state
terminal: Run was already terminal; its state is unchanged
uncertain: Outcome unknown. Retry creation with the same inputs and request ID. Read and confirm state before retrying resume or cancel.
